sources.title: Wergle Flomp Humor Poetry Contest (no fee)

prize.text: $5,100 total: 1st $2,000 + Duotrope/Chill Subs certificates; 2nd $750; 3rd $350; 10 honorable mentions of $200
prize.quote: First Prize: $2,000 ... Second Prize: $750 ... Third Prize: $350 ... Honorable Mentions: 10 awards of $200 each

freeEntry.quote: No fee to enter. Submit published or unpublished work. $5,100 in prizes.

deadline.quote: Please submit one humor poem during August 15, 2026-April 1, 2027

eligibility.text: No age restriction; authors from all countries eligible except Iran, North Korea, Crimea, Russia and Belarus; one poem, 250 lines maximum, English
eligibility.quote: No restriction on age of author. ... Authors from all countries eligible except Iran, North Korea, Crimea, Russia, and Belarus

aiPolicy.text: AI may only be used as a proofreader; AI-written text is prohibited and any AI use must be disclosed. An AI agent cannot write the entry.
aiPolicy.quote: Any writing that you submit to a Winning Writers contest must be composed using your own words, and may not contain any AI-generated text.

payout.quote: Payment method is not described on the contest page read in this pass.

summary: Genuinely free, global, $5,100 in prizes, seven months of runway - but the rules explicitly forbid AI-generated text, so this is a writing task for the human, not for the agent.
flags: Official rules prohibit AI-generated entries; the agent can only assist with editing.
